goal: Make Phase 3 project-specific values recreatable from a straightforward generic editor workflow.

workflow.label: Choose 2D template
workflow.output: default workspaces, canvas model, layer model, validation profile

workflow.label: Configure canvas
workflow.output: tile size, coordinate mode, world/scene/UI views

workflow.label: Import source libraries
workflow.output: source library roots and immutable source catalog

workflow.label: Promote semantic assets
workflow.output: published assets/topology with IDs, rects, anchors, footprints, provenance

workflow.label: Define project vocabulary
workflow.output: zones, terrain families, object kinds, spawn kinds, route kinds

workflow.label: Configure runtime launch
workflow.output: client executable, bridge, saves, dev world, Play From Here policy

workflow.label: Publish profile
workflow.output: project profile used by Game Canvas, docks, Assets, validation, and PIE

acceptance: A non-Havenwild project can be created without editing Rust constants.
Havenwild-specific labels can be recreated through template/profile workflow.
Existing Havenwild behavior remains active during migration.
Generic editor modules can load project identity, workspaces, asset authority, validation, and play settings from profile data.
